title: Cloudflare Radar shows bots now majority of HTML page requests
content:
X author: @TheCoolestCool

Cloudflare Radar's latest 7-day data shows 65% of HTML page requests from bots (35% humans) and bots over 50% of all HTTP requests overall, highlighting rising AI crawler and agent traffic impacts on publisher economics, infrastructure costs, and referral value.
